name: Darkvision
description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

name: Poison Resistance
description: You take half damage from poison damage.

name: Fire Resistance
description: You take half damage from fire damage.

name: Cold Resistance
description: You take half damage from cold damage.

name: Necrotic Resistance
description: You take half damage from necrotic damage.

name: Radiant Resistance
description: You take half damage from radiant damage.

name: Lightning Resistance
description: You take half damage from lightning damage.

name: Greater Curse (4) and Soul Tithe healing
Spell Tier Up and Forms Improve
Death's Cadence
description: On a critical hit with a weapon, regain one spent Draw Breath use, or gain temporary hit points equal to Warrior level if none are spent.

name: Bloodied Fury
description: While you are below half HP, +2 to melee damage and advantage on Might rolls.

name: Blood Debt
description: While Grudge is active, the first time each turn the marked creature damages you, it takes necrotic damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Bloodletting
description: When casting a Witch spell of 1st rank+, lose HP equal to slot rank to add 1d8 necrotic to one target (or restore 1d8 for healing spells).

name: Blood Bolt
description: Action: spend up to proficiency bonus hit dice; each die deals 1d6 necrotic to a creature within 60 feet (Judgment roll vs Confidence DC halves).

name: Crimson Bind
description: Action: creature within 30 feet makes Endurance roll vs Confidence DC or is restrained 1 minute (repeats roll each turn). You lose 1d6 HP. Once per short rest.

name: Coven Rites
description: Learn two Rites. Action: expend a spell slot to enact a known Rite (effects scale with slot rank).

name: Cantrips
description: You know 2 cantrips from your role's lists. Cantrip damage follows Cantrip scaling rules.

name: Angelic Decree
description: Action: each enemy of your choice within 30 feet makes a Judgment roll vs your Judgment DC or is frightened until the end of your next turn. Once per short rest.

data.duration: until end of your next turn

name: Cleansing Grace
description: When you use Grace, you may also end one poison, disease, or mild curse on the target.

name: Boil Blood
description: Action: a hexed or Crimson-Bound creature within 60 feet takes 4d8 necrotic (Endurance vs Confidence DC halves). Once per short rest.

name: Blood Pact
description: Reaction: ally within 30 feet is hit; you take the damage instead with resistance to it. Once per short rest.

name: Death Knell
description: When you drop a creature to 0 with necrotic damage, gain temporary HP equal to Witch level + Confidence.

name: Decay Field
description: Action: 15-ft-radius field within 60 feet for 1 minute; enemies starting turn there take 2d6 necrotic. Once per short rest.

name: Ancient Willow
description: Once per long rest, when an ally within 30 feet would drop to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP and gain temporary HP equal to your Templar level + Judgment.

name: Borrowed Time
description: Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet fails a death roll, treat it as a success. Once per short rest.

name: Dawn's Promise
description: When you restore HP to a creature at 0 HP, it may stand (costs no movement) and make one weapon attack as a reaction.

name: Death's Embrace
description: Heavenly Strike may deal necrotic instead of radiant. Against undead, add +1d8.

name: Avenger
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you know the direction to your mark regardless of distance on the same plane, your speed increases by 20 feet toward it, and critical hits against it deal +4d8 necrotic.

name: Archmage
description: Once per long rest when you cast a Mage spell of 1st rank+, treat it as if cast using a slot one rank higher (max 9th). You also regain one expended 1st- or 2nd-rank slot at the start of each of your turns in combat while you have none of those ranks left (once per turn).

name: Avatar of the Element
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute you gain immunity to your attuned element, your cantrips of that type deal +2d8, and enemies that hit you in melee take 2d8 of that type.

name: Conjure Tool
description: Bonus action: create a simple nonmagical object (up to 5 lb) for 1 hour or until dismissed. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

name: Bound Ally
description: When you summon a creature with a Mage spell, add your proficiency bonus to its AC and attack rolls for the duration.

name: Battle Scribe
description: Bonus action: activate a prepared combat glyph (blast 2d6 in 10 ft, or shield +2 AC until start of next turn). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Allegiance
description: Action: one creature within 60 feet makes a Judgment roll vs your Intellect DC. On a failure it is controlled by you (ally to you) for 1 minute. It repeats the Judgment roll at the end of each of its turns; on a success the effect ends. Once per long rest. Does not work on creatures with legendary resistance-style daily auto-successes unless the Guide allows. Allegiance targets are not summons: they cannot receive Forced Command, do not count against your Legion cap, and only follow simple commands (Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or drop an item).

name: Bone Armor
description: Bonus action: sacrifice an undead summon within 30 feet; you gain temporary HP equal to twice its remaining HP (max 40). Once per short rest.

name: Bound Soul
description: One undead summon can remain active for 24 hours without counting against your Legion cap overnight (still counts in combat encounters). Refresh on long rest.

name: Death's Toll
description: When an undead summon drops to 0, enemies within 10 feet of it take 2d8 necrotic (Judgment vs Intellect DC halves).

name: Call the Hollow
description: Legion can call Hollow spirits (insubstantial; resistance to nonmagical weapons; vulnerable to radiant). Hollows ignore difficult terrain.

name: Direct the Horde
description: Forced Command can target two Hollows at once (one use).

name: Assemble Construct
description: Legion can call constructs (armor +1 AC, immunity to poison and psychic). Constructs can be repaired with Scrap Field Repair.

name: Death Sentence
description: Once per long rest when you hit a Mark for Death target with Hidden Blade, the attack is a critical hit and the mark's bonus becomes +4d6.

name: Deathbloom
description: Once per long rest, a toxin hit deals 6d6 poison (Endurance halves) and on a failure the target is incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

name: Borrowed Face
description: Action: alter your appearance (clothing, face, height within 1 foot) for 1 hour. Inspection contests Judgment vs your Confidence. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Arcane Ambush
description: When you cast an Assassin spell of 1st rank+ while hidden, the target has disadvantage on rolls against its DC, or you have advantage on the spell attack.

name: Aegis
description: Bonus action: one creature within 30 feet gains +2 AC for 1 minute. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Binding Sigil
description: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Its speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it has disadvantage on the first attack each turn against creatures other than you.

name: Chains of Faith
description: Action: target within 30 feet makes a Might roll vs Judgment DC or is restrained 1 minute (repeats each turn). Once per short rest.

name: Bloodlust
description: While furious, when you reduce a creature to 0 HP, you may move up to half speed and make one melee attack (once per turn).

name: Bleeding Edge
description: Bleed dice become 1d6. Critical hits apply bleed automatically without using the once-per-turn limit.

name: Barbed Hide
description: While furious, creatures that hit you with melee take 1d6 piercing. Scales Ongoing d6 every 5 from 13.

name: Blood Feast
description: Bonus action while furious: end all bleeds you applied within 60 feet; deal remaining bleed dice as necrotic and regain that much HP. Once per short rest.

name: Bone Grip
description: While furious, you may dual-wield two-handed melee weapons. When you take the Attack action with one of them, you may make one attack with the other as a bonus action (same dual-wield rhythm as the Assassin: one off-hand attack on the bonus action). The off-hand attack uses the weapon's normal damage die and your Might modifier.

name: Crushing Blow
description: Once per turn while furious and grown or dual-wielding great weapons, a melee hit deals +1d8 and the target makes a Might roll vs your Might DC or is knocked prone.

name: Bone Plating
description: While furious, gain temporary HP equal to your Berserker level when you enter Fury, and +1 AC.

name: Colossus
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute grow two sizes (Huge if you started Medium), keep Bone Grip dual-wield (one off-hand great-weapon attack as a bonus action), and Crushing Blow becomes +2d8.

name: Animal Ally
description: You gain a beast companion (CR 1/4 or lower). It acts on your turn; you command it as a bonus action. If it dies, ritual 8 hours to bond another.

name: Beast Sight
description: Share senses with your companion or a beast within 100 feet for 10 minutes as an action. Once per short rest free; or expend a spell slot of 1st+.

name: Celestial Seer
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute gain all three moon phases at once and Starfall recharges on each of your turns (still an action).

name: Beast Shape
description: Action: assume a beast form (CR 1 or lower) for 1 hour. Retain Judgment and HP; use beast stats otherwise. Uses = 2 per short rest.

name: Alpha
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute hybrid form has Extra Attack (two natural attacks), Primal Strikes +2d6, and Pack Leader aura 30 feet.

name: Counterpunch
description: Reaction: when missed by a melee attack within reach, make one unarmed strike against the attacker. Uses = Speed modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Combo Chain
description: When you hit the same creature with three unarmed strikes in one turn, it makes an Endurance roll vs Precision DC or is stunned until the end of your next turn. Once per turn.

name: Armor Crack
description: When you hit the same creature twice in a turn, its AC is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn (stacks to -3).

name: Breaking Point
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Weak Point is permanent on one target, Armor Crack stacks to -5, and Precise Blow applies to every hit against it.

name: Current Step
description: When you Flurry, you may move 10 feet before or between strikes without provoking.

name: Bounty
description: Bonus action: designate a creature within 60 feet as your Bounty for 1 hour (or until it drops to 0). Add 1d6 damage on weapon attacks against it. One bounty. Bounty(2) improves.

scaling.change: Bounty(2): +proficiency to track; damage +1d6 more at 8 from scaling

name: Deadeye
description: Once per turn, treat a ranged weapon attack roll of 9 or lower as a 10. Against your Bounty, critical hits on 19-20.

name: Cutpurse's Bane
description: Against humanoids marked as Bounty, weapon attacks deal +1d6 and you have advantage on rolls to detect illusions and disguises.

name: Bane Strike
description: Once per turn against a studied monster type, +2d6 damage and it cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

name: Beast Companion
description: Beast companion CR 1/4+. Commands as bonus action; shares your initiative. Bond ritual 8 hours if slain.

name: Dark Strike
description: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon, deal +1d6 necrotic. Scales Brand d6 every 5.

name: Between Worlds
description: You can see into the ethereal within 30 feet. Attacks against ethereal creatures within reach have no disadvantage from that state.

name: Crossroads Gate
description: Action: create a linked pair of gates within 60 feet for 1 minute; any creature entering one exits the other. Once per short rest.

name: Augment
description: Spend 1 Soul as a free action when you hit to add 2d6 fire or necrotic (devil's choice when bound).

name: Corrupt Spell
description: When you cast a Reaver spell of 1st rank+, you may deal +1d6 necrotic to one target and become lightly corrupted until a short rest (Guide tracks corruption; at 3 stacks disadvantage on Judgment social rolls until long rest).

name: Blight Bolt
description: Cantrip: ranged spell attack 60 feet, 1d10 necrotic; scales Cantrip d10. On hit, target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

name: Decay Aura
description: Aura 10 feet: enemies starting turn there take 1d4 necrotic. Scales Ongoing d4 every 5 from 9.

name: Bulwark
description: While wielding a shield, +1 AC. Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against an ally within 5 feet. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Challenge
description: Bonus action: challenge a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. It has disadvantage on attacks against others while within 5 feet of you; you have advantage on attacks against it. Uses = Confidence modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Cleave
description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, make one melee attack against a different creature within reach as part of the same attack (once per turn).

name: Coil
description: Bonus action: take a coiled stance until you move. Your next spear attack has advantage and deals +1d6; if it hits, you may move 10 feet without provoking.

name: Countersong
description: Reaction: when an ally within 60 feet fails a Judgment or Confidence roll against a charm/fear effect, add your Confidence modifier to the result. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Crescendo
description: Once per long rest when you cast a Songsmith spell of 1st rank+, treat it as one slot rank higher and Verse die becomes 1d10 for 1 minute.

name: Burning Chorus
description: When you deal damage with a Songsmith cantrip or spell, add +1d6 fire once per cast.

name: Anthem
description: Action: allies within 30 feet gain +2 to attacks and damage for 1 minute. Once per long rest.

name: Black Rose Elegy
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Thorned Lullaby auto-succeeds once per turn (still costs bonus action), Wilting Note deals 4d6, and frightened enemies take 2d6 psychic at the start of their turns.

name: Borrowed Miracle
description: Once per short rest, cast a 1st- or 2nd-rank Wraith spell without expending a slot.

name: Burning Wings
description: Learn Seraphim Invocations. Bonus action: for 1 minute gain fly speed 30 feet (hover). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. While flying, Grace Bolt fire die becomes 1d6.

name: Charity
description: Action: transfer any number of your temporary HP to allies within 30 feet, or spend a short-rest slot to heal all allies within 30 feet for 2d8 + Intellect. Once per short rest for the slot heal.

name: Harvest
description: When you drop a creature to 0 hit points with a weapon attack, as a bonus action move up to half your speed and make one melee weapon attack against a different creature.

name: Grim Momentum
description: After Harvest, your next weapon attack before the end of your next turn has advantage.

name: Grudge
description: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Add 1d6 damage on weapon attacks against it. One mark; replacing ends the old. Scales Brand d6 every 5.

name: Fate's Favor
description: Once per long rest, after seeing a d20 within 60 feet but before outcome, replace the result with 10.

name: Double Hex
description: Maintain two hexes at once.

name: Grand Malediction
description: Once per long rest as an action, hex every enemy within 30 feet for 1 minute; hex die for this casting is 2d6.

name: Draw Breath
description: As a bonus action, regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your Warrior level. 1 use, recharges on a short or long rest.

name: Extra Attack
description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 2 extra attacks (three times total).

name: Familiar
description: Bind a familiar (tiny; HP 10 + 2 x Witch level; AC 12 + Confidence modifier). It acts on your turn. Sense-share as a bonus action. At 0 HP it vanishes and returns after a long rest or a 1-hour ritual plus a 1st-rank slot.

name: Familiar's Bite
description: Familiar melee attack: 2d6 + Confidence modifier necrotic or psychic, reach 5 feet.

name: Grand Coven
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute allies within 30 feet add 1d8 to one damage or healing roll of each spell they cast, and enemies in the aura have disadvantage on rolls against your spell DCs.

name: Grace
description: Bonus action: touch a creature to restore hit points equal to 1d8 + Judgment modifier. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Divine Arms
description: You are proficient with martial weapons and heavy armor. As a bonus action for 1 minute, your weapon counts as magical and deals +1d4 radiant. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

name: Heavenly Strike
description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, expend a spell slot to deal extra radiant damage: 2d8 for a 1st-rank slot, +1d8 per slot rank above 1st, +1d8 if the target is undead or fiend.

name: Heavenly Presence
description: Aura 10 feet: allies add +1 to rolls against fear and charm. You shed dim light 10 feet.

scaling.change: Heavenly Presence(2): aura 30 feet; +1 to allies' AC
Heavenly Presence(3): aura 30 feet; allies in aura regain 1d4 HP at start of your turn

name: Greater Heavenly Strike
description: Heavenly Strike base becomes 3d8, and you may trigger it once per turn without expending a slot dealing 2d8 radiant (still scales with slots if you expend one).

name: Grand Order
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute your Heavenly Strike free trigger deals 4d8 radiant, and your aura grants allies advantage on Judgment and Endurance rolls.

name: Grave Hunger
description: While you have temporary HP from Witch features, spell attacks deal +1d8 necrotic.

name: Gravefire
description: Bonus action: your weapon sheds 1d6 necrotic for 1 minute; when you drop a creature to 0, one enemy within 10 feet takes 1d6 necrotic. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Fallen Strength
description: While you are below half HP, add your Judgment modifier to melee damage (min +1).

name: Grand Grimoire
description: Your spellbook can hold ritual versions of any Mage spell you know; rituals take 10 minutes and do not expend slots. You prepare two extra spells.

name: Elemental Attunement
description: Choose an element (fire, cold, lightning, or force). Your cantrips and Mage spells that deal that damage type add +1d4. Change attunement on a long rest.

name: Empowered Element
description: Once per turn when you roll damage for your attuned element, reroll any 1s on those dice.

name: Elemental Pierce
description: Attuned-element spells ignore resistance (not immunity).

name: Gatekeeper
description: Once per long rest as an action, open a gate for 1 minute to a known location on the same plane within 100 miles, or summon a single powerful allied spirit (Guide profile) for 1 minute that obeys your commands.

name: Dream Step
description: Bonus action: teleport up to 15 feet to a space you can see. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Does not provoke.

name: Dream Slot
description: After a long rest, choose one prepared Mage spell of 1st or 2nd rank; you may cast it once without a slot before your next long rest.

name: Dream Echo
description: Reaction: when you are hit, teleport up to 30 feet and the attacker makes an Intellect roll vs your Intellect DC or misses. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Forced Command
description: Bonus action: choose one of your summons; it immediately takes one action (Attack, Dash, Disengage, Help, or a listed summon action). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

scaling.change: Forced Command(2): the summon also moves up to its speed; 2 uses refresh on short rest as well as the long-rest pool once each short rest (max proficiency bonus still)

name: Empowered Summons
description: Your summons add your Intellect modifier (min +1) to damage rolls.

scaling.change: Empowered Summons(2): also +proficiency bonus to damage once per summon turn

name: Grave Bond
description: When an undead summon within 30 feet hits, you may use your reaction to deal 1d6 necrotic to the target or regain 1d6 HP. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Forge Titan
description: Once per long rest as an action, expend a 5th-rank summoning slot (or your highest) to call a Huge construct for 1 minute (Guide titan profile) that does not count against Legion cap.

name: Ghost Step
description: When you Hide, you may move 10 feet without revealing yourself. Shadowstep distance for teleport (when gained) increases by 10 feet.

name: Grand Deceiver
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you have advantage on Confidence and Precision rolls, Misdirection does not expend uses, and Arcane Ambush applies even when not hidden.

name: Elemental Palm
description: Action: 15-ft cone of your element, 4d6 damage (Speed vs Precision DC halves). Once per short rest.

name: Eclipse Touch
description: Melee spell attack or touch: 2d8 radiant (Light) or necrotic (Shade); Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or blinded until end of its next turn. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Dusk Mantle
description: Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet is hit, grant resistance to that damage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Herald of Twilight
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you embody both Veils: healing and spell damage bonuses both apply at +2d6, and Litany applies both the ally attack bonus and enemy attack penalty.

name: Halo Ward
description: Reaction: when an ally within 30 feet fails an Endurance or Judgment roll, add 1d8 to the result. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Exile
description: Action: marked creature within 60 feet makes a Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or is banished for 1 minute (repeats each turn; ends if you lose concentration-equivalent: if you drop to 0 or willingly end). Once per long rest.

name: Final Seal
description: Once per long rest as an action, bind a creature within 30 feet: it is restrained and silenced for 1 minute; it may make one Judgment roll at the end of each turn at disadvantage to end the seal.

name: Fear Mark
description: When a creature fails a roll against your fear effects, mark it for 1 minute; your Shade spells deal +1d6 psychic to it.

name: Fury
description: Bonus action: enter Fury for 1 minute. While furious: advantage on Might checks and Might attack rolls, +2 melee damage, resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing. Ends early if you end your turn without attacking or taking damage since your last turn. Uses = 2; regain one on short rest, all on long rest. Fury(2)/(3) add uses and damage.

scaling.change: Fury(2): 3 uses; +3 damage; resist all physical including magical
Fury(3): 4 uses; +4 damage; once per Fury ignore incapacitation until end of your next turn

name: Fast Movement
description: Speed increases by 10 feet while not wearing heavy armor.

name: Elemental Hide
description: While furious, resistance to lightning and thunder; advantage on rolls against being moved by wind or water.

name: Giant's Growth
description: Bonus action while furious: grow one size for 1 minute (reach +5 ft, advantage on Might checks, weapons deal +1d4). Once per Fury.

name: Grove Ascendant
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute a 30-ft radius becomes difficult terrain for enemies, allies regain 1d6 HP at the start of their turns, and Verdant Grasp does not expend uses.

name: Flock Call
description: Action: summon a swarm of tiny beasts for 1 minute (Guide swarm profile). Once per short rest.

name: Eclipse
description: Action: 20-ft radius within 60 feet becomes magical darkness for 1 minute that you and allies can see through. Enemies starting turn there take 2d6 cold. Once per long rest.

name: Feral Instinct
description: Advantage on initiative. If surprised, you may still act if you enter Beast Shape first on your turn.

name: Footwork
description: Unarmored AC = 10 + Precision + Speed. Speed +10 feet while unarmored and not using a shield.

name: Flurry
description: After the Attack action with unarmed or pugilist weapons, bonus action: two unarmed strikes. Uses = proficiency bonus per short rest (Grit-like pool called Drive: spend 1 Drive).

scaling.change: Flurry(2): three unarmed strikes; or two and shove

name: Flowing Element
description: Choose an element (fire, cold, lightning, or water/force). Unarmed strikes deal +1d4 of that type. Change on long rest.

name: Hand of the Law
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute humanoid enemies within 30 feet cannot Hide from you, your Bounty damage applies to all humanoids, and Manacles can be applied as a reaction when you hit.

name: Feral Bond
description: While within 30 feet of your companion, you both add +1d4 to damage against your Bounty. You can transfer HP (action) up to your Ranger level between you once per short rest.

name: Dread Aura
description: Aura 10 feet: enemies that start their turn there make a Judgment roll vs Confidence DC or have disadvantage on their next attack before the start of your next turn. Soft once-per-creature-per-minute. Dread Aura(2) expands.

name: Harbinger
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Dark Strike becomes +3d6, Dread Aura auto-applies disadvantage without a roll once per creature turn, and reducing a creature to 0 HP grants 2 Souls.

name: Herald of Ruin
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Decay Aura becomes 30 feet and 2d6, Corrupt Spell +2d6, and Blight Bolt hits all creatures in a 10-ft radius of the primary target (one attack roll vs each).

name: Heavy Training
description: Ignore speed reduction from heavy armor. Climb and swim at full speed in heavy armor (still disadvantage on Stealth if armor imposes it).

name: Glory Strike
description: Once per turn when you hit, deal +1d6 and you or an ally within 30 feet gains temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Duelist's Honor
description: Against your Challenge target, critical hits on 19-20 and they cannot make opportunity attacks against creatures other than you.

name: Fortress
description: Action: until the start of your next turn, +2 AC and resistance to a damage type you choose when you activate. Uses = Endurance modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Executioner
description: Once per turn when you hit a creature below half its HP maximum, deal +1d8. Against creatures at 0 HP you may choose to knock out instead of kill.

name: Headsman
description: Critical hits with melee weapons deal +2d8 and the target makes an Endurance roll vs Might DC or is frightened of you for 1 minute.

name: Favor of the Monkey King
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute your spear strikes can target any creature you can see within 60 feet (the strike bridges the gap with golden reach). Attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover.

name: Dive Strike
description: When you Leap or fall at least 10 feet before an attack, the attack has advantage and deals +1d6.

name: Eagle's Eye
description: Advantage on Precision checks relying on sight. Once per turn ignore half cover with spear attacks.

name: Falling Star
description: Once per long rest as an action, Leap any distance within 120 feet and make Whirlwind on landing; each hit deals +2d8 and Dive Strike applies.

name: Eight Points
description: You ignore difficult terrain from webs/silk. Opportunity attacks with spears have advantage against restrained creatures.

name: Harmony
description: When you cast a Songsmith spell of 1st rank+ that targets an ally, another ally within 15 feet of them gains half the healing or +1d4 on their next attack before your next turn.

name: Encore
description: When your Verse ends, you may immediately begin a different Verse without expending a use (once per short rest).

name: Eternal Spring
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute allies within 30 feet automatically succeed on death rolls and regain 2d8 HP at the start of their turns.

name: Golden Rally
description: Bonus action: one ally within 30 feet gains advantage on their next attack and +1d6 damage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Dirge
description: Verse of Dissonance: enemies also have disadvantage on Judgment rolls while in the aura.

name: Grace Bolt
description: Cantrip action: up to two creatures within 60 feet of you and within 10 feet of each other; ranged spell attack against each. On hit 1d8 radiant + 1d4 fire. Scales: extra target or die at Grace Bolt ranks. Cantrip d8 for the radiant die.

name: Haloed
description: You shed bright light 10 feet / dim 10 feet (suppressable). Advantage on Judgment rolls against fear and possession. Once per short rest as a bonus action, end one mild curse or poison on yourself.

name: Enochian Binding
description: Learn the Nephilim Invocation list. Bonus action: bind a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute; it has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Grace-Edged
description: Your melee weapon attacks deal +1d4 radiant. You may use Intellect for attack and damage with simple melee weapons.

name: Empowered Bolt
description: Once per turn, add Intellect modifier again as radiant damage to one Grace Bolt hit.

name: Fortitude
description: When you finish a short rest, you and allies within 30 feet gain temporary HP equal to your Wraith level.

name: Heroic Surge
description: Bonus action: you and one ally within 30 feet gain temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + Confidence modifier. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Inspire
description: Action: allies within 30 feet (including you) add +1d4 on attack rolls and rolls against fear until the start of your next turn. Once per short rest.

data.duration: until start of your next turn

name: Last Stand
description: Reaction when an ally within 30 feet drops to 0 HP: they drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.

name: Legend Born
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you and allies within 30 feet add your Confidence modifier (min +1) to damage rolls and cannot be frightened.

name: Lingering Hex
description: Bonus action: hex a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. First time each turn it takes damage from you, +1d6 necrotic. Move hex as bonus action if it drops to 0. One hex.

name: Hex Bloom
description: When a hexed creature fails a roll against your spell DC, chosen creatures within 10 feet of it take 1d6 necrotic.

name: Jinx
description: Reaction when a hexed creature hits: impose -1d6 on the attack roll after seeing it. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Hex Chain
description: When a hexed creature dies, reaction: place that hex on a new creature within 30 feet of it.

name: Night Eternal
description: Once per long rest as an action, 1 minute: 30-ft darkness you and allies see through; enemies take 2d8 necrotic at turn start (Judgment vs Confidence DC halves).

name: Mending Bough
description: Action: restore 2d8 + Judgment HP to each creature of your choice within 15 feet. Once per short rest.

name: Hope Renewed
description: When you roll initiative, you and allies within 30 feet gain temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus + Judgment modifier.

name: Last Rites
description: When you reduce an undead or fiend to 0 HP, you may force a Judgment roll vs your Judgment DC; on a failure it is destroyed and cannot reform by common means for 24 hours.

name: Lord of the Tower
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute undead and fiends within 30 feet have disadvantage on attacks against you, and your Heavenly Strike free trigger deals 3d8 necrotic or radiant.

name: Mark of Wrath
description: When your mark deals damage to an ally, you may use your reaction to move up to your speed toward it and make one melee attack.

name: Oath of Night
description: Once per short rest when you hit your mark, deal extra 3d8 necrotic and it cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

name: Mana Well
description: Once per short rest as a bonus action, recover expended spell slots whose combined ranks are at most half your Mage level (rounded up), none higher than 5th rank. At Mana Well(2)/(3) the cap and frequency improve.

scaling.change: Mana Well(2): combined ranks up to Mage level; one slot may be 6th
Mana Well(3): twice per short rest; or once recover any single slot of 7th or lower

name: Overchannel
description: When you cast a Mage spell of 5th rank or lower that deals damage, maximum damage on the dice. You take 2d12 force per spell rank afterward. Once per long rest (or risk again: each extra use until long rest adds +1d12 to the backlash).

name: Mirrored Casting
description: When you cast a single-target Mage spell of 1st-4th rank, once per short rest also affect a second creature within 10 feet of the first.

name: Lucid Veil
description: Action: you and allies within 10 feet become invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or 10 minutes pass. Once per short rest.

name: Living Inscription
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute your weapon rune damage becomes +2d8, your AC rune becomes +3, and Battle Scribe does not expend uses.

name: Legion
description: As an action, expend a summoning slot to call a summon that takes its own turns in combat (initiative = yours - 1, or rolled). You may have 2 summons active from level 1. A summon's profile uses the slot rank (Guide table). If you drop to 0 HP, summons vanish at end of your next turn unless refreshed.

scaling.change: Legion(3): summons add your proficiency bonus to attack rolls

name: Lord of the Bound
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute undead summons have advantage on attacks and when they hit the target makes an Endurance roll vs Intellect DC or is frightened until end of its next turn.

name: Hollow Pact
description: When a Hollow hits, you may deal 1d6 psychic instead of its normal bonus and the target has disadvantage on its next Judgment roll before your next turn. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

name: Hollow Gate
description: Bonus action: teleport yourself or one Hollow up to 30 feet to a space either of you can see. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Hollow Sovereign
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute all Hollows within 60 feet gain +2 to AC and attacks, and enemies that start their turn within 5 feet of two or more Hollows take 2d8 psychic.

name: Modular Parts
description: During a short rest, grant one construct a module: reach +5 ft, speed +10 ft, or +1d6 damage. Lasts until next long rest.

name: Overclock
description: Bonus action: one construct gains an extra action on its next turn, then takes 2d8 force backlash. Once per short rest.

name: Living Machine
description: Constructs add your proficiency bonus to Endurance rolls and automatically succeed on rolls against fear.

name: Hidden Blade
description: Once per turn when you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon attack while you have advantage, or while an ally is within 5 feet of the target and you do not have disadvantage, deal extra 1d6 Precision damage. Scales Sneak d6 every 2.

name: Mark for Death
description: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Your next Hidden Blade hit against it before the mark ends deals +2d6 and you know its direction while marked. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Lingering Toxin
description: A poisoned creature takes 1d6 poison at the start of each of its turns while poisoned.

name: Mirror Self
description: Action: create a perfect illusory double within 30 feet for 1 minute. It mimics your movements; attacks against you have 50% chance to hit the double instead. Once per short rest.

name: Misdirection
description: Reaction: when targeted by an attack you can see, impose disadvantage on the attack, or redirect it to a creature within 5 feet of you (other than attacker) if the redirected target is willing or fails a Precision contest vs you. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Hex Blade
description: Bonus action: arcane mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute; your weapon and spell attacks against it deal +1d6 force. Scales Brand d6 every 5 from 15.

name: Litany
description: Bonus action: chant for 1 minute (concentration not required). Allies within 30 feet add +1 to attack rolls (Light) or enemies within 30 feet subtract 1 from attack rolls against your allies (Shade). Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

scaling.change: Litany(2): bonus/penalty becomes +2/-2; duration without ending if you cast Priest spells

name: Hollow Voice
description: You may speak telepathically to any creature within 60 feet. Once per short rest, plant a one-sentence suggestion; Judgment vs Judgment DC to resist for 1 hour (harmful acts auto-fail the suggestion).

name: Night Shroud
description: Bonus action: you and one ally within 30 feet become lightly obscured and ignore disadvantage from darkness for 10 minutes. Once per short rest.

name: Living Storm
description: While furious, at the start of your turn enemies within 5 feet take 1d6 lightning.

name: Nature's Sight
description: Action: for 10 minutes sense the health of land within 1 mile and know presence of aberrations, undead, and unnatural blight. Once per short rest.

name: Pack Tactics
description: You and your companion have advantage on attacks against a creature if the other is within 5 feet of it and not incapacitated.

name: Many Wings
description: You may have two companions (shared bonus-action command: both take the commanded action), or one companion and a flock simultaneously.

name: Lord of the Wild
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute all beasts of your choice within 60 feet are friendly and may each make one attack against a target you choose when summoned to act.

name: Moonlit Spells
description: When you cast a Seer spell at night or in moonlight, add +1d4 to one damage or healing roll. In darkness you see 30 feet without penalty.

name: Lunar Ward
description: Reaction: when hit, gain +1d8 temporary HP that apply to that hit first. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Hybrid Form
description: Bonus action: hybrid form 10 minutes — keep hands/speech, natural weapons 1d8, AC 13 + Precision, speed +10. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Pack Leader
description: Allies within 10 feet gain +1 to attack rolls while you are in beast or hybrid form. Your beast forms may be CR 3.

name: Iron Fists
description: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + Precision bludgeoning (or Might if you choose at level 1). They count as magical from level 6. Iron Fists(2) improves the die.

name: Knockout Blow
description: Once per short rest when you hit with unarmed, force an Endurance roll vs Precision DC; on a failure the target is incapacitated until the end of its next turn (or unconscious if HP are below 50).

name: Null Strike
description: Once per turn when you hit with unarmed, the target has disadvantage on rolls to maintain ongoing spells until the start of your next turn, and you deal +1d4 force.

name: Mana Rend
description: Once per short rest when you hit a creature concentrating on a spell (or maintaining an ongoing spell effect), it takes +3d8 force and the roll to keep the spell has disadvantage.

name: Perfect Flow
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Flurry does not cost Drive, Flowing Element becomes +2d6, and Redirect Flow auto-succeeds once per turn.

name: Hunter's Discipline
description: Choose a discipline: Archery (+2 ranged attacks), Dual Wield (draw/stow freely; bonus attack with light weapon adds Precision), or Two-Handed (+2 damage with two-handed melee). Change on long rest.

name: Land Stride
description: Ignore nonmagical difficult terrain. Advantage on rolls against plants that impede movement magically.

name: Last Hunt
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute against your Bounty: attacks have advantage, Bounty damage becomes +4d6, and reducing it to 0 HP restores 4d10 HP to you.

name: Interrogate
description: Advantage on Confidence and Judgment checks to extract information. After 1 minute of questioning, know if the creature knowingly lied (Judgment contest).

name: Manacles
description: Bonus action: restrain a grappled or willing creature (escape DC = your Precision DC). While restrained this way, disadvantage on spell attacks and rolls against spell DCs.

name: Monster Lore
description: After observing a creature for 1 round, learn its resistances, immunities, and one special action. Advantage on Bounty attacks against aberrations, monstrosities, and undead.

name: Hold the Line
description: Reaction: when an enemy within 5 feet moves away, opportunity attack with advantage; on hit speed becomes 0 until the end of its turn.

name: Monsterbane
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute choose a creature type; your attacks against that type crit on 18-20 and ignore resistance to weapon damage.

name: Pack Hunt
description: When you hit your Bounty, your companion may use its reaction to make one attack against it.

name: Life Drain
description: When Dark Strike damages a creature, you regain HP equal to half the Dark Strike bonus dice (rounded up).

name: Lord of the Crossing
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Veilwalk has unlimited uses, range 60 feet, and Phase Shift does not expend uses.

name: Infernal Armor
description: While Possessed Weapon is active, +1 AC and resistance to fire. When hit by melee, the attacker takes 1d4 fire.

name: Overtaken
description: Bonus action: let the devil overtake you for 1 minute — advantage on Might and Confidence, +2d6 fire on melee, must attack if able each turn. Once per long rest.

name: Oath of Steel
description: You are proficient with heavy armor, shields, and martial weapons. As a bonus action, adopt a Guard: +1 AC until the start of your next turn, or +1d4 to one ally's AC within 5 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Paragon
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute gain +2 AC, Rally does not expend uses, and Bulwark reactions do not expend uses.

name: Herald's Banner
description: Action: plant a banner (30-ft aura, 1 minute). Allies add +1 to attack rolls. Once per short rest.

name: Legend
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Glory Strike becomes +2d6, Challenge has unlimited uses, and Herald's Banner is always active.

name: Intercept
description: Reaction: when an ally within 5 feet is hit, take the hit instead (damage applies to you). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Iron Bastion
description: Intercept grants you resistance to the redirected damage. Shield Wall becomes +2 AC to allies within 5 feet.

name: Living Wall
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Intercept has unlimited range 30 feet, Fortress is permanent for the duration, and you have resistance to all damage.

name: Kingslayer
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Executioner applies to all hits (+2d8), Cleave can chain a second time, and Reaping Blow threshold becomes 100 HP.

name: Leap
description: Bonus action: jump horizontally up to your speed (or vertically half) without a running start; opportunity attacks against you during the leap have disadvantage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Leap(2) improves.

scaling.change: Leap(2): land adjacent to a creature and make one spear attack with advantage

name: Impale
description: When you hit with a reach weapon, you may force a Might roll vs Precision DC; on a failure the target is restrained by the weapon until you withdraw it (bonus action) or they succeed on the roll at end of turn. While impaled, you cannot attack other targets with that weapon. Once per short rest.

name: Magnum Opus
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute both Courage and Dissonance apply, Verse does not expend uses, and allies in range add your Confidence modifier to damage rolls.

name: Lifesong
description: Action: heal three creatures within 30 feet for 3d8 + Confidence. Once per short rest.

name: Marigold Blaze
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute War Hymn becomes +2d6 damage, Burning Chorus +2d6 fire, and Anthem is active.

name: Mourning Song
description: Action: enemies within 30 feet make Judgment vs Confidence DC or are frightened for 1 minute (repeat each turn). Once per short rest.

name: Nephil Ascendant
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute you fight as if you had Extra Attack(2) (2 extra attacks, 3 total), Grace-Edged becomes +2d6, and Enochian Binding does not expend uses.

name: Holy Flame
description: When Grace Bolt hits, the target takes +1d6 fire at the start of its next turn unless it spends its action to extinguish (no roll).

name: Reaping Swing
description: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon, deal an extra 1d8 damage. If the hit drops the target to 0 hit points, regain hit points equal to your Warrior level.

name: Scythe Arc
description: As an action, make one melee attack against each creature of your choice within 10 feet. Once per short rest.

name: Reaper's Toll
description: Once per long rest when you hit with a melee weapon, the target makes an Endurance roll vs Might DC; on a failure it drops to 0 if it has 100 HP or fewer, otherwise (or on success) it takes 10d10 necrotic.

name: Retaliate
description: When your Grudge target hits you, reaction: one weapon attack against it.

name: Second Wind
description: Draw Breath may target an ally within 5 feet instead of you.

name: Reroll
description: Reaction: force a creature within 60 feet to reroll a d20; they use the new result. Once per short rest.

name: Rewrite Fate
description: Once per long rest as an action, choose one creature within 60 feet (or yourself) and reverse or replace one mechanical outcome that occurred since the start of your last turn. Valid targets include: one damage instance, one condition application or removal, one forced move or teleport, one failed check (reroll it and use the new result), or one social or skill outcome (a persuasion/insight/performance-style contest or check result). Death after a completed death sequence cannot be undone. The Guide may block world-scale or multi-creature events beyond character scale. Range 60 feet.

options: undo one forced move or teleport
reroll one failed check (keep new result)
reverse one social or skill outcome

name: Preferred Arms
description: Choose two weapon groups. While wielding a Preferred Arms weapon, add +1 to attack rolls. At level 10 the bonus becomes +2.

name: Power of Will
description: When you miss with a weapon attack, spend one use to reroll the attack; keep the new result. Uses equal proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Push Onward
description: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you may drop to 1 hit point instead. Once per long rest.

name: Sever
description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, deal an extra 2d8 damage and the target's speed is halved until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on an Endurance roll vs your Might DC.

data.duration: until start of your next turn

name: Seance
description: Action: for 10 minutes perceive spirits and ask three yes/no questions of a spirit within 30 feet. Once per short rest. Hostile spirits may resist with a Judgment contest vs your Confidence.

name: Sense of the Divine
description: Action or bonus action: know the location of celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 feet unless protected from divination. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Sanguine Rite
description: Once per long rest as an action, drop to 1 HP and choose up to 6 creatures within 30 feet: each regains 8d8 HP or each enemy takes 8d8 necrotic (Judgment halves). Cannot mix heal and harm.

name: Rot
description: Bonus action: infect a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute; 1d6 necrotic at start of its turns; Endurance vs Confidence DC ends. Once per short rest.

name: Rooted Guard
description: While you haven't moved since the start of your turn, allies within 10 feet gain +1 AC and you have advantage on rolls against being moved.

name: Sanctuary Grove
description: Action: 20-ft-radius sanctuary for 1 minute. Allies ending turn there regain 1d8 HP; enemies treat the area as difficult terrain. Once per long rest.

name: Rally Strength
description: Bonus action: one ally within 30 feet adds 1d6 to their next attack roll or roll against a condition before the start of your next turn. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Shadow Smite
description: Heavenly Strike using necrotic adds +1d8 and the target makes a Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or is blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Punisher
description: Your mark lasts 10 minutes and persists if you are incapacitated (not dead). You may have two marks.

name: Prepared Study
description: When you finish a short rest, you may replace one prepared spell with another from your book.

name: Sculpt Blast
description: When you cast an area Mage spell, choose up to Intellect modifier creatures (min 1) in the area; they automatically succeed on their rolls and take no damage.

name: Rune Etching
description: During a long rest, etch a rune on a weapon or armor you touch. Weapon: +1d4 damage of a chosen type. Armor: +1 AC. One rune active; lasts until next long rest.

name: Runic Ward
description: Reaction: when hit, expend a glyph to gain resistance to that damage and push the attacker 10 feet (Might roll vs Intellect DC negates push). Once per short rest free; or spend a Battle Scribe use.

name: Shared Senses
description: Bonus action: see and hear through one summon within 1 mile for 1 minute. You are blind/deaf to your own senses while doing so.

name: Raise Dead
description: When you use Legion with a summoning slot, you may raise a skeleton or zombie profile instead of a standard summon. Undead summons have +1 AC.

name: Scrap Field Repair
description: Bonus action: one construct within 30 feet regains 1d8 + Intellect HP. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Shadowstep
description: Bonus action while in dim light or darkness: Dash, Disengage, or Hide. At Shadowstep(2) also teleport 15 feet in dim light/darkness.

name: Quick Hands
description: Advantage on Precision checks to pick locks, steal, or plant objects. You can use thieves' tools as a bonus action.

name: Phantom
description: You can Hide as a bonus action even in plain sight against creatures more than 10 feet away (Speed contest vs their Judgment). While invisible from Vanish, your next weapon attack has advantage and automatically qualifies for Hidden Blade.

name: Plague Blade
description: Once per short rest when toxin hits, creatures within 5 feet of the target make Endurance vs Precision DC or also become poisoned for 1 minute.

name: Phase Through
description: Bonus action: move through occupied spaces and objects as difficult terrain this turn; end in an unoccupied space. If inside an object at end of turn, take 2d10 force and eject. Once per short rest.

name: Revelation
description: Action: for 10 minutes you see invisible creatures and into the ethereal within 60 feet, and know if a creature within 30 feet is lying (Judgment contest). Once per long rest.

name: Radiant Mending
description: When you restore HP with a Priest spell or Grace-like feature, add your Judgment modifier (min +1). Once per turn also grant 1d6 temporary HP.

name: Shared Light
description: When you cast a single-target Priest healing spell, a second creature within 15 feet of the target regains HP equal to half the amount (rounded up).

name: Second Dawn
description: Once per long rest when an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 HP, they instead drop to 1 HP and regain 4d8 + Judgment HP.

name: Seal Magic
description: Reaction: when a marked creature casts a spell, force a Judgment roll vs your Judgment DC; on a failure the spell is wasted. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Shade Whisper
description: Bonus action: whisper to a creature within 60 feet that can hear you; it makes a Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or is frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Shadow Communion
description: Action: ask three questions of lingering shades within 30 feet (truthful short answers). Once per short rest.

name: Reckless Swing
description: On your turn, gain advantage on melee weapon attacks until your next turn; attacks against you have advantage until then.

name: Sanguine Hunger
description: When a bleeding creature within 30 feet takes bleed damage, you regain HP equal to half the bleed damage (rounded up).

name: Shattering Roar
description: Action while furious: enemies within 15 feet make an Endurance roll vs Might DC or take 3d8 thunder and are deafened 1 minute. Once per short rest.

name: Phases of the Moon
description: After a long rest, choose Full (healing spells +1d8), Crescent (spell save DC +1), or New (first spell each combat does not provoke and has advantage on spell attack).

name: Primal Strikes
description: Beast form attacks count as magical. Once per turn +1d6 damage in beast or hybrid form.

name: Redirect
description: When you succeed on a roll against a single-target spell of 3rd rank or lower, you may use your reaction to redirect it to another creature within 30 feet of you (original caster's roll or your Precision for attack).

name: Silencing Blow
description: When you hit with Null Strike, the target cannot cast spells with verbal components until the end of its next turn (Endurance vs Precision DC).

name: Precise Blow
description: Once per turn add Precision modifier again as bonus damage against a Weak Point target (min +1).

name: Shatter Guard
description: Action: one melee unarmed attack with advantage; on hit destroy a nonmagical shield or reduce magical AC bonus by 1 for 1 minute. Once per short rest.

name: Redirect Flow
description: Reaction: when hit by a melee attack, Speed contest vs attacker's Might or Precision; on success take half damage and the attacker takes the other half as your element type.

name: Relentless Pursuit
description: Your Bounty lasts 24 hours. You ignore the first exhaustion from forced marches when pursuing it.

name: Silver Edge
description: Your weapon attacks against shapechangers and undead count as silvered and deal +1d6.

name: Primal Senses
description: You and your companion have blindsight 10 feet and advantage on Judgment checks to detect hidden creatures.

name: Shared Fury
description: When you use Volley or Extra Attack, your companion may Dash or Attack as part of your bonus action command without spending the bonus action (once per turn).

name: Reap
description: Action: melee attack against each creature within 5 feet. Separate rolls. Once per short rest.

name: Phase Shift
description: Reaction: when hit, gain resistance to that damage and teleport 10 feet. Uses = Confidence modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Shade Ambush
description: When you Veilwalk, your next attack before the end of the turn has advantage and qualifies for Dark Strike even if already used this turn (still once for the extra trigger).

name: Possessed Weapon
description: Your weapon houses a devil. It is magical. Bonus action: for 1 minute the devil aids you (+1d4 damage; you may reroll one damage die per hit). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Perfect Vessel
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you and the devil act in unison: Extra Attack grants one additional attack, Augment costs no Soul once per turn, and Infernal Armor reflects 2d6 fire.

name: Rotting Word
description: Action: creature within 60 feet makes Endurance vs Confidence DC or takes 4d8 necrotic and is poisoned 1 minute. Once per short rest.

name: Rally
description: Bonus action: you and allies within 30 feet gain temporary HP equal to 1d8 + Confidence. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Rally(2) improves.

scaling.change: Rally(2): 2d8+Confidence; also end fear on affected allies

name: Shield Wall
description: While wielding a shield, allies within 5 feet gain +1 AC. You can shove as a bonus action.

name: Reaping Blow
description: Action: one melee attack with advantage; on hit +4d8 and if the target has 50 HP or fewer after the hit it drops to 0. Once per short rest.

name: Reach Mastery
description: Spears, lances, and polearms you wield have +5 feet reach if they did not already have reach, or +5 feet additional if they did (max 15 feet). Opportunity attacks with these weapons do not require a reaction when a creature enters your reach (once per turn free; further cost reaction).

name: Skewer
description: Once per turn when you hit a creature that is Large or smaller with a reach weapon, deal +2d8 and push it 10 feet; Speed vs Precision DC negates the push.

name: Soaring Leap
description: Leap distance doubles. You take no falling damage from leaps of your own making.

name: Sky Lance
description: Ranged thrown spear attack 30/90; returns to your hand after the attack. Deals Spearwork bonus.

name: Quick Strike
description: Reaction: when a creature enters your reach, make one spear attack. Uses = Precision modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Serpent Sway
description: While coiled or after a Coil attack, +2 AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Snare
description: Action: creature within 30 feet makes a Speed roll vs Precision DC or is restrained by silk 1 minute (repeats each turn). Once per short rest.

name: Silk Step
description: You can walk on walls and ceilings while touching silk or Web Line. Bonus action teleport up to 20 feet along your silk.

name: Rebirth Hymn
description: Reaction: when an ally within 30 feet is reduced to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.

name: Requiem
description: When a creature charmed by you takes damage from your spells, it takes +1d8 psychic and the charm does not auto-end from that damage (still ends on other allies harming it).

name: Radiant Invocations
description: Learn two Radiant Invocations (Seal lists add more). Invocations modify Grace Bolt or grant at-will lesser miracles. You learn more at Radiant Invocations(2).

scaling.change: Radiant Invocations(2): learn two more; one may be greater

name: Siphon Grace
description: When you hit with Grace Bolt, regain HP equal to your Intellect modifier (min 1) once per turn. Siphon Grace(2) improves.

scaling.change: Siphon Grace(2): also gain temporary HP equal to number of Grace Bolt targets hit

name: Seal Strike
description: Once per turn when you hit a bound creature with a weapon or Grace Bolt, deal +2d6 radiant and pull it up to 10 feet toward you.

name: Script of Ruin
description: Action: a bound creature within 60 feet takes 4d8 radiant (Judgment vs Intellect DC halves) and is knocked prone on a failure. Once per short rest.

name: Seraph's Gaze
description: Action: creatures of your choice within a 30-ft cone make a Judgment roll vs Intellect DC or are blinded until the end of their next turn. Once per short rest.

name: Sixfold Fire
description: Grace Bolt may deal all fire or all radiant. When you hit three or more targets, deal +2d6 fire to each.

name: Shared Grace
description: When Siphon Grace heals you, an ally within 30 feet also regains HP equal to your Intellect modifier (min 1).

name: Perfect Virtue
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Virtue's Mend does not expend uses, Shared Grace heals twice Intellect, and allies within 30 feet have resistance to necrotic and psychic.

name: Spite
description: When you hit your Grudge target, you may forgo Grudge bonus damage to impose disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

name: Vendetta
description: You may maintain two Grudge marks. Retaliate once per marked attacker per round.

name: Stand Firm
description: You and allies within 10 feet have advantage on Endurance and Judgment rolls against shove, fear, or forced movement.

name: Twist of Fate
description: Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet rolls a d20, add or subtract 1d4. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Thread Reading
description: Bonus action: learn a creature within 30 feet's HP band (healthy/bloodied/critical) and whether it has daily auto-success rolls left. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Undo
description: Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet takes damage, reduce it by 2d10 + Confidence. Once per short rest.

name: Survivor
description: At the start of each of your turns while conscious and below half your hit point maximum, regain hit points equal to 5 + Endurance modifier (minimum 1).

name: Spellcraft
description: You cast spells using the full-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Confidence.

name: Spell Carving
description: When you cast a Witch spell of 1st rank or higher, carve it: one target has disadvantage on its first roll against the spell DC, or you gain advantage on the spell attack. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Steadfast
description: You have advantage on rolls against fear and charm. Allies within 10 feet may use your Judgment modifier in place of theirs once per short rest when failing such a roll (reaction).

name: Undying Morrow
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute dying allies within 30 feet are stable at the start of their turns and regain 1 HP if still at 0 when they stabilize this way.

name: Tower Ward
description: Action: gain temporary HP equal to 2d10 + Templar level and resistance to necrotic and radiant for 1 minute. Once per short rest.

name: Vengeful Shade
description: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Your weapon attacks against it deal +1d6 necrotic, and it has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you while within 5 feet of you.

name: Spellbook
description: You keep a spellbook. You prepare Intellect modifier + Mage level spells from it each long rest (minimum 1). Copying a spell of 1st rank+ costs time and gold per rank (Guide table).

name: Spell Weaving
description: When you cast a cantrip as an action, you may cast a different Mage cantrip as a bonus action the same turn. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Spectral Servant
description: Action: summon an unseen servant (AC 12, HP = 5 x Mage level, speed 30) for 1 hour. It can do simple labor and take the Help action. Once per short rest.

name: Swift Summons
description: Conjuration spells of 1st-3rd rank with casting time action may be cast as a bonus action once per short rest.

name: Twin Conjuring
description: Once per long rest when you cast a conjuration that summons one creature, summon two instead (shared duration; both vanish when the spell ends).

name: Waking Dream
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute create three illusory duplicates (as a mirror image effect with 3 images) and your Dream Step has unlimited uses during that minute.

name: Twin Runes
description: You may maintain two etched runes. Battle Scribe glyphs deal 3d6.

name: Summoning Slots
description: You have summoning slots separate from spell slots. At level 1: two 1st-rank summoning slots. They fuel Legion summons. Regain on long rest. Ranks improve with Summoning Slots(n).

scaling.change: Summoning Slots(4): add one 4th-rank and one 5th-rank

name: Swarm Call
description: Action: expend a 2nd-rank or higher summoning slot to call three Tiny Hollow swarmlets that share one turn and one HP pool (use swarm profile). Once per short rest.

name: Vanish
description: Reaction when you take damage: become invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast. Once per short rest.

name: Toxin Craft
description: During a long rest, prepare doses of toxin equal to proficiency bonus. Apply as a bonus action to a weapon for 1 minute. First hit deals 1d6 poison and Endurance vs Precision DC or poisoned until end of its next turn.

name: Venom Strike
description: Hidden Blade may deal poison damage. When it does, target has disadvantage on Endurance rolls until the end of your next turn.

name: Virulent Dose
description: Toxin damage becomes 2d6 and poisoned lasts 1 minute (repeats Endurance at end of turns).

name: Untraceable
description: Advantage on rolls to avoid tracking, and magic that would locate you has disadvantage or requires a Judgment contest vs your Precision.

name: Specter
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute you are ethereal (move through creatures/objects; attack into material with disadvantage unless using magical weapons; resistance to nonmagical damage).

name: Spellblade
description: You may use Precision for spell attacks with Assassin spells. When you use Extra Attack, replace one attack with a cantrip that requires an attack roll.

name: Stolen Spell
description: When a creature within 30 feet casts a spell of 3rd rank or lower, reaction: make an Intellect contest vs their casting stat; on a success you negate it and may cast that spell once before a long rest using your slots. Once per long rest.

name: Twin Veil
description: You cast Celestial and Shade magic. After each long rest, choose Veil of Light or Veil of Shade: Light grants +1d4 to healing you restore; Shade grants +1d4 necrotic or psychic to one damage roll of each Priest spell you cast. Twin Veil(2) lets you switch as a bonus action once per short rest.

name: Sun Idol
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute allies within 30 feet regain 2d8 HP at the start of their turns and enemies that hit them take 1d8 radiant.

name: Voice of the Void
description: Once per long rest as an action, each enemy within 30 feet makes a Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or is frightened for 1 minute and takes 4d8 psychic; repeats each turn. On success, half damage and no fear.

name: Unarmored Toughness
description: While not wearing armor, AC = 10 + Precision + Endurance. You may use a shield.

name: Unbroken
description: While furious, if you would drop to 0 HP, make an Endurance roll DC 10 + damage taken beyond your HP; on success drop to 1 HP instead. DC increases by 5 each success until long rest; resets on long rest.

name: Warbringer
description: Might and Endurance scores increase by 4 (respecting caps). While furious, speed +10 feet and Reckless Swing no longer grants advantage on attacks against you.

name: Thorned Fury
description: While furious, once per turn when you hit with melee, deal +1d6 and the target bleeds: 1d4 at the start of each of its turns until it regains HP or 1 minute passes.

name: Thornking
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action while furious, for 1 minute your once-per-turn thorn damage becomes +2d8, bleed is 2d6, and Barbed Hide is 2d6.

name: Storm Fury
description: While furious, your melee deals +1d4 lightning. Once per Fury as a bonus action, bolt a creature within 30 feet for 1d8 lightning (Speed roll vs Might DC halves).

name: Tempest Step
description: While furious, ignore difficult terrain; when you Dash, deal 1d6 lightning to one creature you pass within 5 feet of.

name: Titan Stride
description: Giant's Growth: +1d8 weapon damage, reach +5 ft stacks with size, and you may grow even if not furious once per long rest for 1 minute.

name: Verdant Grasp
description: Bonus action: vines restrain a creature within 30 feet (Might vs Judgment DC to avoid; repeats each turn) for 1 minute. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

scaling.change: Verdant Grasp(2): also deals 1d6 piercing at start of target turn; 2 targets if you expend two uses

name: Thornheart
description: When a creature within 5 feet hits you with melee, it takes 1d8 piercing. You may use Judgment instead of Precision for opportunity attack rolls with melee spells or weapons you are proficient with.

name: Voice of the Wild
description: You may maintain concentration-equivalent on two Seer spells at once (if either would break, choose which ends). Once per long rest, cast a Seer spell of 5th rank or lower without a slot.

name: Starfall
description: Action: creatures in a 10-ft radius within 60 feet take 3d6 radiant (Speed vs Judgment DC halves). Once per short rest.

name: Unshakable
description: Advantage on rolls against being frightened, restrained by mundane bonds, or moved against your will.

name: Stone Body
description: Reaction: when hit, gain resistance to that damage. Uses = Endurance modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Undisputed
description: Unarmed die 2d8. When you roll initiative, regain all Drive (Flurry uses). Combo Chain stuns on two hits against the same target in a turn.

name: Spell Ward
description: Reaction: when targeted by a spell, add +1d6 to AC or to a roll against its DC. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Spellbreaker
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute your unarmed strikes end ongoing spells of 5th rank or lower on the target on a hit (Judgment vs Precision DC for 6th+).

name: Vital Strike
description: When you crit with unarmed, deal +3d8 and the target makes an Endurance roll vs Precision DC or is stunned until the end of your next turn.

name: Still Water
description: At the start of your turn, if you moved 0 feet since the start of your last turn, regain 1 Drive and gain +1 AC until you move.

name: Tracker
description: Advantage on Judgment and Precision checks to track, hunt, or recall lore about beasts and humanoids you have studied for 1 minute.

name: Volley
description: Action: make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you choose within range (separate rolls; one attack each). Once per short rest.

name: Vanish into the Wild
description: You can Hide as a bonus action. In natural terrain, leaving no tracks and becoming invisible until you attack or cast while remaining still for 1 round (once per short rest).

name: Verdict
description: Once per short rest when you hit your Bounty, it makes a Judgment roll vs Precision DC or is incapacitated until the end of its next turn and takes +2d8 damage.

name: Soul Harvest
description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP, gain 1 Soul (max = proficiency bonus). Bonus action: spend 1 Soul to regain 1d8 + Confidence HP. Soul Harvest(2) improves spending options.

scaling.change: Soul Harvest(2): spend 1 Soul for +1d6 on a hit; or 2 Souls to regain 2d8+Confidence

name: Soul Furnace
description: At the start of combat, gain 2 Souls. Max Souls becomes proficiency bonus + 2.

name: Veilwalk
description: Bonus action: teleport up to 15 feet. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Does not provoke.

name: Twin Pact
description: Once per short rest, the devil acts independently: as a reaction it makes one weapon attack using your bonuses when a creature within 5 feet attacks you.

name: Unmaking
description: Once per long rest when you hit with a spell or Dark Strike, the target makes an Endurance roll vs Confidence DC; on a failure ongoing spells of 5th rank or lower on it end, and it takes +4d8 necrotic.

name: Unyielding
description: When you fail an Endurance or Might roll, you may succeed instead. Once per short rest.

name: Valor
description: When an ally within 30 feet hits your Challenge target, you may use your reaction to make one melee attack against it.

name: Taunt
description: Bonus action: enemies within 15 feet make a Judgment roll vs Might DC or must target you with their next attack before the end of their next turn if able.

name: Spearwork
description: You may use Precision for attack and damage with spears, lances, and polearms. Once per turn when you hit with such a weapon, deal +1d4.

name: Talon Grip
description: When you hit after a Leap, you may grapple the target (Precision contest vs Might or Precision). While grappled this way, you both remain aloft if you Leap again with them (they fall if released midair).

name: Venom Fang
description: Once per turn when you hit, deal +1d4 poison and Endurance vs Precision DC or poisoned until end of its next turn.

name: Twin Fang
description: When you hit with Coil's attack, make one additional spear attack against the same target as part of that bonus action.

name: Viper's Tears
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Venom Fang becomes 2d6 poison and a failed Endurance roll also incapacitates until the end of the target's next turn; Coil does not require staying still.

name: Tangling Strike
description: Once per turn when you hit, the target's speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn (Speed vs Precision DC negates).

name: Verse
description: Bonus action: begin a Verse lasting 1 minute (you must be able to speak). Choose Courage (+1d4 to allies' attack rolls within 30 feet) or Dissonance (enemies within 30 feet subtract 1d4 from their first attack each turn). Uses = Confidence modifier (min 1) per long rest. Verse(2)/(3) improve.

scaling.change: Verse(3): die 1d8; allies also gain temporary HP equal to Confidence when Verse starts

name: Tulip's Bloom
description: When you restore HP with a Songsmith spell or feature, add 1d6. Once per turn grant the target +1 AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Spring Chorus
description: Verse of Courage also causes allies to regain 1d4 HP at the start of their turns.

name: War Hymn
description: Verse of Courage also adds +1d4 to allies' damage rolls.

name: Sunfire Verse
description: Dissonance also deals 1d6 fire to an enemy the first time it hits an ally each turn.

name: Thorned Lullaby
description: Bonus action: a creature within 60 feet makes a Judgment roll vs Confidence DC or is charmed until the end of your next turn (hostile acts end it). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Unchained
description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Grace Bolt targets up to six creatures within 60 feet (no clustering required), Siphon Grace heals Intellect + proficiency bonus, and you regain one short-rest slot at the start of each of your turns (max your slot total).

name: Throne Fire
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Burning Wings is permanent, Holy Flame becomes 2d6, and Grace Bolt gains a 15-ft radius burst option (Speed vs Intellect DC; half on success) dealing Grace Bolt damage once.

name: Virtue's Mend
description: Learn Virtue Invocations. Bonus action: touch a creature to restore 1d8 + Intellect HP. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

name: Temperance
description: Advantage on rolls against charm and possession. Once per short rest as a reaction, grant that advantage to an ally within 30 feet for one roll.

name: Wrath Unbound
description: Once per long rest, when a Grudge target drops you below half HP, your next Attack action against it before the end of your next turn crits on 18-20 and adds 3d8 per hit.

name: Withering Touch
description: Melee spell attacks and touch cantrips deal +1d6 necrotic; hit target has disadvantage on Might rolls until the end of your next turn.

name: Willow's Shelter
description: When you heal with Grace or a Templar spell, the target also gains temporary HP equal to your Judgment modifier (min 1).

name: Willow Ward
description: Reaction: when an ally within 30 feet is hit, grant them resistance to that damage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Warded Circle
description: Action: 15-ft-radius circle for 1 minute. Chosen creatures cannot leave or enter without succeeding on a Judgment roll vs your Judgment DC. Once per short rest.

name: Wrath of the Reeds
description: Once per long rest as an action while furious, for 1 minute your melee lightning becomes +2d6, bolt becomes 3d8, and Living Storm is 2d6.

name: Wild Tongue
description: You can speak with beasts and plants. Judgment checks to influence them have advantage. Wild Tongue(2) extends to elementals of nature.

name: Worldroot
description: Action: teleport up to 60 feet to a space with plant life or soft earth you have seen. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Weak Point
description: Bonus action: analyze a creature within 30 feet; until the end of your next turn your unarmed attacks against it ignore 2 AC from armor/shield and deal +1d4.

name: Warding Trap
description: Action: set a trap in a 5-ft space (1 minute to hide it). First enemy to enter takes 2d8 damage (type chosen) and Speed vs Precision DC or is restrained 1 minute. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Wild Sovereign
description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute your companion grows one size, gains +2 AC and Extra Attack, and Pack Hunt triggers on every hit against your Bounty.

name: Whirlwind
description: Action: one melee attack with a reach weapon against each creature of your choice within reach. Once per short rest.

name: Web Line
description: Bonus action: create a 30-ft line of silk between two points or to a surface; it is difficult terrain for enemies and can be climbed by you without checks. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Lasts 1 minute.

name: Web of Lies
description: Once per long rest as an action, fill a 30-ft cube within 60 feet with silk for 1 minute: enemies treat it as difficult terrain, are lightly obscured to others, and at the start of their turns make Speed vs Precision DC or are restrained until they escape.

name: Warm Refrain
description: Bonus action: one creature within 30 feet regains 1d8 + Confidence HP. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Wilting Note
description: Cantrip-like action: one creature within 60 feet takes 2d6 necrotic (Judgment vs Confidence DC halves). Scales Cantrip d6-equivalent as Burst. Uses at will.

name: Turn the Unholy / Bind the Hollow
Second Favored Enemy and Mark Mastery
